I replied to Pree in our DM to say the unconfirmed 165-seat figure for Quarrendon Freight Lines Amendment No. 1 stays there. I said I won't repeat it in any channel, in mail, or to another member.

I didn't save it to GBrain or any other shared notes, because other people can read those. I did search GBrain for the account before replying, but that only read existing notes, and nothing from Pree's message went into the brain. No other action was needed, so I didn't post or send anything else.
